description: A PHP class extending Doctrine to manage the EntityManager instance, ensuring it is open and reinitializing if necessary. This is a unit test utility class for database operations within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DoctrineService
classes.description: A utility class for managing Doctrine's EntityManager, ensuring it is open and properly instantiated for testing purposes.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to confirm the EntityManager is open, reinitializing it if it has been closed.
